hypothesis: Component-level byte and CPU attribution can identify recurrent or residual work whose removal reduces official runtime while costing less than the current 110677-byte forecast margin.
kill_condition: No component has runtime leverage with a conservative full-score penalty below 110677 bytes, or held-out/disjoint transfer exhausts the score margin.
promotion_condition: A frozen removal policy passes exact 1M and 10M replay, projects at or below 108000000 after counted package bytes, and reduces controlled whole-codec runtime enough to justify official calibration.
title: Endpoint428 measured-work pruning with score budget
